limitations: QA bands absent: numeric values cannot be certified cloud-free or scientifically usable.
Two historical years do not validate a current anomaly baseline or disease diagnosis.
LST is surface skin temperature, not POWER T2M air temperature.
Collection version must be recovered from original subset metadata; CMR granules do not prove subset version.

weather_outlook.unit_validation: Column and request semantics match provider documentation; original daily_units response absent, so no runtime unit assertion is possible
weather_outlook.transformation: No numerical conversion; blank CSV cells become null. Column aliases mapped to documented variables.
limitations: No forecast/current-weather fetch log entries, raw provider response, UTC offset, issue time or response units contributed.
Local-date range does not establish freshness. API processing duration generationtime_ms would not establish issue time either.
Model/provider mix and resolution cannot be inferred from an ERA5-Land/IFS comment.
Soil forecast variables are absent on the last two days; do not fill them or treat the whole row as complete.
